source.concept: vampire fang greatsword: curved bone-white fang blade with crimson edge, dark red and black bat-wing shaped cross guard with a red diamond gem, dark red wrapped grip, black pommel with a red blood drop shape

curved bronze scimitar-like saber, golden-bronze blade curving to one side with a fuller groove and a faint green edge glow, bronze cross guard with downward curled tips and a round green gem in the center, dark brown cord-wrapped grip, round bronze pommel

butcher's cleaver: broad rectangular steel blade with a round hole near the spine top, beveled bright edge, short silver ferrule, dark brown wooden handle with two silver rivets, angular handle end; vertical with blade on top

dragonslayer greatsword: very large dark brown-bronze blade with a golden central fuller, golden wing-shaped cross guard with a red gem in the center, a golden radiant halo ring with spikes fused solidly behind the blade base, red leather grip with gold ring bands, gold spike pommel

flame sword: grey steel blade with a wavy zig-zag edge and a glowing orange-red flame pattern inlaid in the center, diamond-shaped gold guard with a red gem at the blade base plus curved gold crescent quillons, dark leather grip with gold ring bands, red crystal spike pommel
R2 tripo-3d/weapons/w_frost/w_frost-concept.png

singularity greatsword: broad dark grey-silver frame blade with a starry purple-black cosmic inlay and a swirling purple black-hole spiral in the middle, ornate silver cross guard with a purple black-hole disc, thin purple rings with small dark orbs fused solidly to the blade, dark purple grip, purple crystal pommel

city guard longsword, wide grey steel blade with a fuller groove and chisel point, flat silver cross guard, brown leather grip with silver ring bands, round silver pommel with a small green tassel hanging from it
R2 tripo-3d/weapons/w_hunter/w_hunter-concept.png

plain iron short sword, wide flat silver-grey blade with a central fuller groove and a chisel-shaped point, simple flat silver cross guard, brown leather grip with silver ring bands, round silver pommel
R2 tripo-3d/weapons/w_king/w_king-concept.png

knight order longsword: grey steel blade with a wavy edge and a golden central fuller stripe ending in an arrow tip, gold cross guard with two red diamond gems and a central gold diamond boss, dark leather grip with gold ring bands, red crystal spike pommel

phoenix greatsword: very WIDE blade shaped like a large spread flame-feather wing with layered orange, yellow and red feathers and flame tongues at the sides, a golden phoenix bird emblem with red gem at the cross guard, brown wrapped grip, gold and red crystal spike pommel

plague scythe-like weapon: long twisted dark brown wooden vine staff handle with green moss and glowing green mushrooms along it, large curved crescent bone-cream blade with holes and sickly green glow at the top, small mushrooms at the bottom end; vertical staff with the curved blade on top

frost greatsword: translucent pale ice-blue crystal blade with a white snowflake emblem near the top, faceted ice crystal shards fused to the cross guard around a silver diamond, steel-blue wrapped grip, ice crystal pommel

rune sword: grey steel blade with a wavy edge and a glowing orange-yellow angular rune pattern inlaid in the center, gold winged cross guard with two red gems, dark leather grip with gold ring bands, red crystal spike pommel
R2 tripo-3d/weapons/w_rusty/w_rusty-concept.png

sigil greatsword: broad stone-tan blade with glowing orange-yellow angular rune patterns inlaid, gold cross guard with square diamond ornaments and a round gold gem, brown wrapped grip, gold diamond-shaped pommel

steel broadsword, wide grey-silver blade with a fuller groove and chisel point, flat silver cross guard with a square green emerald gem in the center, brown leather grip with silver ring bands, round silver pommel

thunder greatsword: wide wavy blade of glowing electric blue with white lightning-crack patterns inside a silver-grey frame, silver winged cross guard with a round blue gem, dark blue wrapped grip with silver bands, blue crystal pommel; electric arcs rendered as solid blue crystal shards attached to the blade edges

sun greatsword: very large dark brown-bronze blade with a golden central fuller, golden winged cross guard with a sunburst of gold spikes around a red round gem, a golden radiant sun ring with big star spikes fused solidly behind the blade base, red leather grip with gold ring bands, gold spike pommel
wooden training sword carved from light brown wood with visible grain, wide flat blade with chisel point, wooden cross guard, grip wrapped with dark brown leather bands, round wooden pommel
